prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one extraordinarily polished high-fidelity iPhone app SCREEN, flat straight-on screen design, portrait approximately 1170 x 2532. This is a visual concept for a private digital wardrobe and personal stylist for Muslim women, first used by a wife with a mixed Western and Pakistani wardrobe. It builds modest outfits ONLY from owned clothes. Clean minimal native iOS design, real large readable UI type, generous yet useful space, accessible dark text. Native status bar at top with 9:41, dark camera island, native safe areas, familiar bottom tab bar with four labeled SF-symbol-like icons Today / Closet / Looks / Stylist, home indicator. Avoid a phone hardware mockup, angled device, poster, marketing landing page, decorative flowers, Islamic ornament, sparkles, gradients, random cards, invented product name or logo, shopping, prices, sale labels, badges, performance claims, watermarks or attribution. Use high-quality photoreal clothing cutouts, fabric details and soft natural contact shadows, not drawings. Common owned outfit in every version: full-length flowing mushroom-taupe open abaya, opaque long ivory tunic, cream wide-leg trousers, dusty mauve hijab, dark chocolate flat shoes. No humans or bodies. Primary task is making today's outfit from these existing pieces. Small trustworthy supporting copy. Earth colors with very restrained flower pink, purple and white. This is a usable operational app screen, not an art poster. Direction B, Olive atelier. Disciplined wardrobe archive with warm chalk #F7F6F0, moss #56634B primary, dark bark #293026, linen-tinted image wells, muted mauve detail #A68DA8. Pure system sans UI typography, no serif. Task-first and beautifully organized. Top native large title "Your closet" and a prominent plus icon button on right. Smaller text "A little less deciding. A little more you." A native search field "Find a piece". Horizontal category filter buttons "All", "Layers", "Tops", "Bottoms", "Hijabs"; All active olive. Middle of screen: airy TWO-column THREE-row wardrobe grid of actual cutout garments in subtly rounded almost-white image wells, labels beneath each image outside the wells. Six pieces are "Taupe abaya", "Ivory tunic", "Wide-leg trousers", "Mauve hijab", "Chocolate flats", "Rose kurta". The rose kurta is knee-length Pakistani straight tunic, long sleeves, tasteful subtle embroidered neck, matte rose cotton. No prices and no extra badges. Individual garment photos are detailed product photography on clean chalk, no humans. At bottom before tab bar one shallow quiet pale sage strip with text "Your next outfit is already here." and a full-width olive filled "Style these pieces" button. Tab Closet active. Small flower-purple dot used as selected swatch only. Dense enough to be useful, never a spreadsheet or a shopping catalog.
